title: eo-claim-lint claim document
description: A single machine-checkable claim derived from Earth observation or remote sensing data. This schema describes how a claim is stated, not whether it is true: it makes no statement about the scientific accuracy of any value, and it establishes no legal or evidentiary standing.

schema_version.description: Version of this claim document schema.

claim_id.description: Identifier for this claim, unique within whatever set the producer maintains.

data_origin.description: Where the underlying data came from. Independent of how far it has been processed.

data_processing.description: How far the underlying data has been transformed. Independent of where it came from.

evidence.description: References backing the claim. May be empty: whether a given claim type requires evidence is a linting decision, not a structural one.

dateTime.description: RFC 3339 date-time. A timezone offset is required; a naive local time is not accepted.

claimType.description: observation: recorded by an instrument or supplied by a data source. estimate: produced by a model, interpolation, or statistical procedure. interpretation: a meaning assigned to an observation or estimate.

dataOrigin.description: measured: recorded by an instrument. synthetic: generated, for example for a demo or a fixture; this does not mean false. unknown: not established.

dataProcessing.description: raw: as delivered by the source. derived: computed by a defined deterministic procedure. modeled: produced by a model that adds assumptions; this does not imply synthetic. unknown: not established.

uncertainty.description: A declared uncertainty about the claimed value. Note that 'lower <= upper' cannot be expressed in JSON Schema and is enforced by the Python model instead.

confidence.description: Confidence level as a fraction, not a percentage.

claim.description: The statement being made and the value it carries.

statement.description: The claim in prose, as a reader would understand it.

value.description: The claimed value. Arrays and nested objects are out of scope for this version.

spatialScope.description: Where the claim applies. Geometry beyond a bounding box is out of scope for this version; no GIS or CRS transformation is performed.

bbox.description: West, south, east, north. Ordering constraints are enforced by the Python model.

temporalScope.description: Either a single instant or a period, never both.

checksum.description: A digest as recorded by the producer. It is not verified against any artifact and confers no authenticity.

evidenceReference.description: A pointer to something that backs the claim.

processing.description: How the claimed value was produced. Never place credentials, tokens, passwords, or personal data in 'parameters'; this object is written into published artifacts.

parameters.description: Free-form JSON object. Deliberately unconstrained so that producers can record their own parameters.
